intro.title: Pull-to-Refresh Feed
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a mobile feed page that users can pull down to refresh, loading new content. You will learn how to use the Ionic Refresher component to detect the pull gesture and trigger a data reload. The core programming concept involves handling asynchronous events to update your app's state and UI. You'll implement this using Angular's data binding and TypeScript within an Ionic + Capacitor project.
intro.usecase: Pull-to-refresh is a fundamental mobile interaction pattern that appears in countless real-world apps where users need fresh content. You'll find it in social media feeds like Instagram or Twitter, messaging apps like WhatsApp, email clients like Gmail, and news readers like Flipboard. This pattern allows users to manually trigger content updates with a natural pulling gesture, providing immediate feedback that data is being refreshed. As a mobile developer, implementing pull-to-refresh correctly ensures your app feels responsive and follows platform conventions that users already understand.
